## Tanzania safaris

- [All safaris](https://www.smickzanzibar.com/safaris): Mikumi and Nyerere day trips from Zanzibar ($430+), Serengeti fly-in safaris ($1,676+), Tarangire & Ngorongoro 2 days ($526+), 5–10 day northern circuit safaris.

## Other services

- [Holiday packages](https://www.smickzanzibar.com/packages): 3 to 10 day Zanzibar packages with hotel, meals, transfers and excursions ($390+).
- [Transfers](https://www.smickzanzibar.com/transfers): airport/ferry to Stone Town $15, Paje/Jambiani $40, Chwaka $40, Nungwi/Kendwa $50 (per vehicle).
- [Car rental](https://www.smickzanzibar.com/car-rental): Toyota Corolla, RAV4 4x4, Alphard and Hiace — self-drive or with a driver, rates on request.
- Extra services (price on request): accommodation, kayaking, drone & camera services, holiday escort, night club bookings.
